core_philosophy: Premium, editorial, and confident. High-end SaaS that feels like a curated magazine. Embrace asymmetry, dramatic typography, and absolute minimalism in CTA placement.

typography.import_instructions: Fonts are self-hosted via @fontsource with no render-blocking Google Fonts CSS.

hierarchy.h1: font-serif text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#1A1614]
hierarchy.h2: font-serif text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#1A1614]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Use generous spacing. Do not cram elements. Allow the warm cream paper background to act as negative space. Optical alignment is crucial.

mobile_density.philosophy: Completely separate visual layout from interactive hitbox. Visual elements stay highly compact; hit targets expand invisibly.
mobile_density.hit_target_minimum: 44px–48px via invisible ::after pseudo-elements, transparent outer padding, or container bounds

buttons.primary: bg-[#8B3FD6] text-white font-sans text-sm font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-[#6B2B99] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#1A1614] font-sans text-sm font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none border border-[#1A1614]/20 hover:border-[#1A1614] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.text_link: text-[#1A1614] font-sans text-sm font-medium hover:text-[#4F1E7B] transition-colors duration-300 underline-offset-4 hover:underline

cards.agent_card: bg-transparent border border-[#1A1614]/15 p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col justify-between hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(26,22,20,0.08)] transition-all duration-300

header.content: Logo (font-serif italic text-2xl), Navigation links center, 'Start free trial' primary button right. ONE button only. 'Sign in' as a secondary text link next to it.

hero.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center section_padding mt-16
hero.design: Massive H1 using Fraunces, maybe italicizing 'voice + email'. Single primary CTA below. Use the abstract 3D spheres image as a floating element or absolute positioned backdrop graphic, ensuring text contrast.
hero.trust_signals: Below the CTA, display 'TLS 1.3 • SOC 2 • HIPAA-ready' in the mono font, text-xs, muted.

integration_logos.layout: The 'Editorial Ribbon' approach. py-16 border-y border-[#1A1614]/10
integration_logos.design: Use text-based logos or highly minimalist SVG logos (Lucide/React Icons) representing integrations (Salesforce, Zendesk, Stripe, Hubspot). Desaturated. Wide spacing (gap-16 or gap-24). Can be a slow marquee or a centered flex row.

agent_directory.design: Instead of a 2x5 cramped grid, use an asymmetric layout. Featured agent spans 8 columns, others span 4. Use large mono typography for the phone numbers. Ensure generous internal padding inside cards. Add 'Call Now' text links.
agent_directory.details: Cards should have a flat editorial feel, not standard rounded SaaS cards. 0px border radius.

proof_tiles.layout: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-px bg-[#1A1614]/10 border border-[#1A1614]/10 section_padding
proof_tiles.design: Massive stats. e.g., '24/7' in 5xl Fraunces. Label 'Availability' in mono font below. The 1px gap creates grid lines between items, revealing the border color. Background of items is #EFE9DC to create technical grid look.

footer.design: Massive Wireline logo text at the bottom. Clean, spaced out link columns above it. Fix redundant CTAs. Keep it elegant.

images.description: Abstract floating 3D spheres in cream and purple. Use as a decorative element in the hero section, perhaps scaled down and floating near the heading, or as a subtle background. Do not let it obscure text.
White textured paper. Can be used as a very low opacity (e.g., 5%) mix-blend-multiply overlay on the background for added tactile feel, if needed.

media.icons_instructions: Use lucide-react or react-icons for integration and feature icons. Keep stroke-width thin (1 or 1.5) for an elegant look.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and links must have clear hover states. Buttons darken, text links change color to brand purple. Cards lift slightly with a shadow.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Use framer-motion for elegant fade-in-up entrances. Keep animations subtle and editorial, not bouncy.

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, agent cards, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the #EFE9DC and #1A1614 color scheme. Do not introduce generic grays (like slate or zinc) from Tailwind unless tinted to match the cream/ink.
Use 0px border radius (rounded-none) for buttons and cards to enforce the editorial, print-like aesthetic.
Eliminate all redundant CTAs. There should only be one 'Start free trial' button in the header, one in the hero, and one at the bottom of the page.
Fix the cut-off text issue by using proper padding (py-24, p-8) and avoiding fixed heights on text containers.
Build the Agent Directory using the Tetris bento grid logic. No dense tables or 2-column small cards.
Implement the 'Proof Tiles' using the Grid Borders (Technical Look) surface strategy mentioned in the sections.
